meta.name: components
meta.description: React component file structure and patterns for Trezor Suite. Use when creating or reviewing React components, including prop passing and component organization.

copy.tagline: 按规范创建和审查 React 组件结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 Trezor Suite 中编写或审查 React 组件
copy.tagline_en: Create and review React component structures with patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write or review React components in Trezor Suite

howto.what: 当你要创建或审查React组件时，Claude会按照Trezor Suite的规范提供指南，包括文件结构顺序、组件内部代码布局（如选择器、状态、hooks、效果、渲染）以及属性传递的最佳实践（只传递所需部分，避免大对象）。
howto.when: 当你请求创建或审查React组件时触发，尤其是涉及组件结构、属性传递和组织方式。

say.text: 帮我把这个组件按Trezor Suite规范重构文件结构。
say.note: Claude会指导你调整导入、样式、常量等顺序。

say.text: 审查这个组件的属性传递，有没有可以优化的地方？
say.note: Claude会检查是否只传递了必要属性。

say.text: 我的组件里用到了useDispatch和useEffect，顺序对吗？
say.note: Claude会按照推荐顺序给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you in creating or reviewing React components following Trezor Suite's conventions: file structure order, internal component layout (selectors, state, hooks, effects, render), and prop passing best practices (pass only necessary parts, avoid large objects).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or review React components, especially regarding component structure, prop passing, and organization.

say_en.text: Restructure this component file following Trezor Suite conventions.
say_en.note: Claude will guide the order of imports, styles, constants, etc.

say_en.text: Review this component's prop passing for optimization opportunities.
say_en.note: Claude checks if only necessary props are passed.

say_en.text: Is the order of useDispatch and useEffect correct in my component?
